title: Khaled / Founder & pilot
description: Dubai-based founder and pilot building AI products for customer operations and personal workflows. Explore prototypes, product progress and validation milestones.
about: My product work focuses on customer support, equipment quotations, leasing and personal workflows. I am developing Frame to turn spoken thoughts and conversations into useful memory and follow-through. Each product has a defined development stage and a specific next validation milestone.

projects.name: Quote Operations

projects.audience: HVAC equipment sales and estimating teams

headline: Equipment quotes,
ready for review.
projects.summary: AI-assisted quotation preparation for HVAC sales teams. Match requests to equipment and pricing, with estimator and approver review.
features: With AI set up, paste an English or Arabic request from email or WhatsApp, or upload one printed PDF equipment list. The app reads the lines and quantities.
Review suggested products and available prices beside the request. Open a line to check where its product or price came from.
See missing quantities, uncertain selections and unavailable prices first. Keep technical decisions with your engineer.
Confirm the products, prices and terms, then get a colleague’s approval and download the quote. Customer changes get a new version; the earlier quote stays saved.
nextFocus: Compare one past request with the team’s approved quotation
Connect the products, selling prices and approval rules used for that job
Measure corrections and preparation time, separately from approval waiting time

updates.text: A prepared equipment quote can be reviewed in the public sample. The next step is a customer pilot with an approved catalogue and real team access.

headline: Your words,

features: Capture an idea or conversation, then keep the original recording alongside your editable note.
Find earlier notes and open the source behind a memory answer.

Test supported-language transcription and on-device AI honestly
Measure whether people return because the remembered context is useful
projects.demoNote: The visual overview is a workflow illustration, not an app screenshot. Earlier video assets remain archived separately and are not evidence of the assistant.

updates.text: Signed build 3.0.0 (7), uploaded at 13:18:15 Dubai, improves the interface and protects unsaved edits, follow-up drafts and newer saved content. The full suite executed 103 checks: 102 passed and one device-only skip. Simulator draft save/reopen and native Calendar cancel/save callbacks were verified. Build 7 processing completion and group assignment remain unverified; build 4 remains the only verified assigned internal beta.

Signed Frame 3.0.0 (6) uploaded at 11:35:59 Dubai. The latest changes clarify foreground recording and save retries, and make all saved actions discoverable. Simulator UI verified finding and completing a fourth action; 25 targeted checks passed with one device-only skip, plus 27 iOS 18.5 compatibility checks. Apple processing/assignment for build 6 is unverified; build 4 remains the verified internal release.

Earlier video prototype — Native Frame 2.0.1 (3) refresh adds a forest-green Studio home, three relatable illustrated comedy starters, editable local story notes and My videos navigation. All 44 native tests passed, with simulator checks of the new flows and notes after relaunch. The signed build was processed by Apple and assigned to Owner Testing (one existing tester). App Store Connect confirms that the owner installed the previous build on an iPhone 16 Pro. The mobile app still has no connected AI filmmaking; new-build device acceptance, creative acceptance and audience validation remain open.

Earlier video prototype — Backend 0.8.6 completed a 30-second explainer in the local gallery: four real planning stages, Kling motion, operator-authored 3D diagrams, continuous narration, aligned captions and timed sound. The film cost about $2.27 including rejected work; 200 mocked tests, full media decoding, gallery playback and download integrity passed. Manual direction and repairs were still needed. Founder creative acceptance and a reliable unaided workflow remain pending.

Earlier video prototype — Product direction corrected after the founder rejected the slideshow: complete AI-directed films are the goal. Backend 0.8.5 adds staged planning and pre-spend review safeguards, verified with 189 mocked tests and a browser fixture. Actual media review, richer editing and the mobile connection remain unfinished. No new generation credits were spent.

Earlier video prototype — Frame 2.0.0 (1) is now available for owner-only internal TestFlight testing as “Frame: Photos to Reels”; the app itself is named Frame. The distribution-signed build was uploaded, processed by Apple and assigned to the internal group, with the owner invited. Installation and acceptance on a real iPhone remain unverified. This is not an external or public beta or an App Store release. The offline editor supports drafts, gallery recovery and safer import, export and voice saving, with 44 Simulator tests. It has no Frame login or cloud AI integration. The separate web studio offers Kling and Seedance with 174 mocked tests; AI creative acceptance remains pending. A subsequent simulator walkthrough verified editing, relaunch, gallery recovery, missing-video retry and completed Files sharing. The inspected export shows that landscape framing and template quality still need work.
Earlier video prototype — Developing a conversation-led route from an idea to a short film. The next proof point is one complete, reviewed film with a reliable download.

projects.technicalReadiness: Build 3.0.0 (4) remains verified in Owner Testing (Internal, one tester); signed build 3.0.0 (7) uploaded successfully at 13:18:15 Dubai on 20 September 2026. Build 7 improves visual fidelity, protects unsaved note edits and drafts, prevents stale changes from overwriting newer content, and corrects recording-resume setup. Its full suite executed 103 checks: 102 passed and one device-only check was skipped. Simulator draft save/reopen and native Calendar cancel/save callbacks were verified. Apple processing completion and group assignment for build 7 remain unverified. Physical microphone, recording recovery, on-device AI and language quality remain unverified.
projects.commercialReadiness: Private beta available for owner testing. Repeat use and willingness to pay remain unvalidated; no paid launch is available.
projects.positioning: Capture, source-linked recall and reviewed follow-through in one personal workspace.
projects.outcome: Recover the context behind your decisions and prepare your next step; usefulness remains under validation.
deliverables: A saved recording and editable note
Relevant source passages from saved notes
Reviewed tasks and editable follow-up drafts
useCases: Capture a thought before it is forgotten
Recall what was agreed in an earlier conversation
Prepare a follow-up from a saved note
projects.nextAction: Verify capture, source recall and a reviewed next step on a real iPhone, then observe repeat use with a small beta.

readinessChecks.detail: AI requires iOS 26.4+ and a compatible enabled model. English output; mixed Arabic–English speech quality remains unverified.

This is not physical-device Calendar, microphone or file-protection acceptance; AI/language checks still need a supported device.

readinessChecks.detail: Build 4 remains verified in Owner Testing (Internal, one tester). Signed build 3.0.0 (7) uploaded successfully at 13:18:15 Dubai on 20 September 2026. intro:
I build AI software for customer operations and video production.
Based in Dubai, with a background in aviation.
